subject: Lighthouse Health — Discovery recap and proposed MPA (timelines & owners)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T15:02:00Z
Subject: Lighthouse Health — Discovery recap and proposed MPA (timelines & owners)

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for carving out time today — appreciated the candid discussion. I summarized the key pain, measurable goals, and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) below so your team can review and share with stakeholders. I attached an editable MPA (MPA_Lighthouse_v1.xlsx) and a short one-pager on the Redwood deployment options.

Quick recap of what we heard
- Pain: High latency and inconsistent throughput for batch triage workflows; growing token cost with current vendor; lack of exportable audit logs for regulated audits.
- Impact: Slower clinician workflows, increased manual review time, and procurement constraints tied to data residency.
- Primary goals (90-day): 1) Proof-of-concept to reduce median latency by ~40% for the triage path; 2) Validate per-call cost savings with batching and cache; 3) Demonstrate audit/log pipe for compliance.

Proposed MPA (milestones, owners, target dates)
- Kickoff & environment access — Lighthouse infra + Redwood onboarding (owner: David Chen / kimberly_park) — target: 2026-06-21
- Data & security questionnaire completed (owner: Samira Khan + procurement@lighthousehealth.com) — target: 2026-06-28
- Tech POC (integration + baseline metrics) — owner: Redwood engineering (Ben Carter) — target: 2026-07-19
- Cost & performance review (joint) — owner: Lighthouse analytics + Redwood solutions — target: 2026-07-26
- Executive review & procurement approval (decision) — owner: Lighthouse exec sponsor + procurement — target: 2026-08-06

Open items we flagged during the call
- SOC 2 evidence and data residency: we noted Lighthouse prefers US-only logs and a written SOC 2 summary.
- Scope: initial POC will focus on the triage use case (not user-facing clinically actionable recommendations).
- Success criteria: 40% latency reduction + <10% increased operational overhead vs current flow.

Requests / next steps
1) Please confirm the stakeholders and dates in the MPA above (I included David and procurement as next owners).
2) Please upload the security questionnaire or let us know if you want us to share our standard questionnaire (we can pre-fill some sections).
3) Would you be open to a 30-minute technical onboarding call next week to scope environment access (Ben + David + Samira)?

If that looks right I’ll update the attached MPA and send an invite for the tech call.

Thanks — happy to iterate.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MPA_Lighthouse_v1.xlsx, redwood-one-pager.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@lighthousehealth.com>

Cc: David Chen <david.chen@lighthousehealth.com>, procurement@lighthousehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-15T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Lighthouse Health — Discovery recap and proposed MPA (timelines & owners)

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and for pulling together the MPA draft. A few clarifications from our side:

> On Sun, Jun 14, 2026 at 15:02 Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> > - Pain: High latency and inconsistent throughput for batch triage workflows; growing token cost with current vendor; lack of exportable audit logs for regulated audits.
> > - Impact: Slower clinician workflows, increased manual review time, and procurement constraints tied to data residency.

Confirmed — this aligns. Additional inputs:
- Stakeholders: Exec sponsor is Dr. Lena Morales (PM), technical owner will be David Chen (cc’d). Procurement lead is Mark Hsu (procurement@lighthousehealth.com).
- Compliance note: our security team requires SOC 2 Type II summary and a signed data processing addendum (DPA) before any infra access. We also need logs retained in US-only regions for the duration of the POC.
- Budget: we have an allocated POC budget but need an estimated committed spend for the POC window to get procurement commitment (ballpark $15–25k).

About next steps:
- Yes to the 30-min technical call. David is available Tue 6/22 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 6/23 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Please include SOC 2 summary and DPA draft with the next MPA version.

I’ll try to get Mark Hsu to acknowledge the procurement timeline by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Samira
Director of Clinical Platforms | Lighthouse Health
samira.k@lighthousehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2020
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@lighthousehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Lighthouse Health — Discovery recap and proposed MPA (timelines & owners)

Appreciate the quick response, Samira — helpful context.

I updated the plan based on your notes and attached: 1) MPA_Lighthouse_v2.xlsx (with Dr. Lena Morales listed as exec sponsor and Mark Hsu added as procurement owner), 2) SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf, and 3) a draft DPA.

Responses to items you raised:
- SOC 2 / DPA: attaching the SOC 2 summary and a draft DPA for your legal team to review. If needed we can route the DPA through your procurement portal or DocuSign (link in the Drive file).
- US-only logs: Redwood can stage logs to a US-region bucket for the POC and include retention controls — Ben can put together a short infra diagram on the tech call.
- Budget: Ben, could you prepare a POC cost estimate and a conservative committed spend range we can share with Mark?

Proposed tech-call slot: Tue 6/22 10:30–11:00 PT (fits David’s window). I’ll send an invite once you confirm.

If you confirm the tech-call I’ll finalize the MPA dates: kickoff 6/21 -> POC complete 7/19 -> review 7/26 -> exec decision 8/06.

Thanks — looping Ben on pricing and Aditya on procurement/contracting logistics.

Best,
Kimberly

Samira / Kimberly — quick note on the POC pricing and what we’ll include so procurement has what it needs:

- Estimated committed spend for the 4-week POC window (infra + support): $18k–$22k depending on peak throughput. I’ll produce a short line-item estimate (compute, storage for logs, support hours).
- Deliverables: baseline performance report, configuration notes (batching, KV cache), and a short runbook for moving to Dedicated or Private if you want to continue.
- Payment terms: net 30 standard; we can provide a one-time POC invoice to speed procurement if that helps.

I’ll add the estimate to the MPA_v2 and share by EOD Friday so Mark has a record.

Thanks,
